about.statement: Systagma comes from Greek: <g>systēma</g>, a whole made of parts, and <g>tagma</g>, something set in order.
about.followUp: That's our job. We arrange people, processes and data into software that works as a single system, and we show in numbers what changed.

services.lead: Every problem calls for a different mix of software, data, automation and AI. We design the mix and deliver the whole, so you don't have to coordinate several vendors.

faq.lead: What people usually ask before we start.

faq-custo.q: How much does a project cost?
faq-custo.a: It depends on scope and format. After a first conversation we send a written proposal with scope, timeline and budget. When the scope is still open, we start with a two-week, fixed-price discovery sprint.

faq-prazo.a: An MVP usually takes 8 to 16 weeks. The exact timeline is in the proposal, with deliveries every two weeks so you can follow along.

faq-ideia.q: Do I need to know which solution to buy?
faq-ideia.a: No. An idea or a clearly described problem is enough for a first conversation. The discovery sprint exists to turn that into scope.

faq-codigo.a: Your company. Repositories, cloud accounts, domains and documentation are in your name from the start, and we hand everything over in order when the contract ends.

faq-sistema.q: Can you take over a system that's already running?
faq-sistema.a: Yes. We start with a technical audit of the code, infrastructure and risks, and only then propose a plan.

faq-suporte.a: We stay with you if it makes sense: support with fixes, monitoring where it applies, improvements, new features and integrations. If you prefer, we train your team to take the system over.

faq-ia.q: Where does AI make sense in my company?
faq-ia.a: Usually where there's a lot of text, many documents or repetitive reading and triage: assistants that search your knowledge base, data extraction from documents, request classification. We start from the problem, and when a simple automation solves it, that's what we recommend.

faq-comunicacao.a: A direct channel with the team (email, Slack or WhatsApp), a short weekly meeting and a demo every two-week cycle.

faq-dados.q: How do you handle personal data?
faq-dados.a: We follow Brazil's LGPD: we collect the minimum needed, document how data is processed, and apply access control and encryption in the systems we build. When needed, we sign a data processing agreement.

faq-brasil.q: Do you work with companies all over Brazil?
faq-brasil.a: Yes. We work with companies across the country, and the team has people in different regions, including the Northeast and Belém (Pará).

faq-idioma.q: Do you work with companies outside Brazil?
faq-idioma.a: Yes, in Portuguese and English, with meetings in a time zone that works for both sides.
